stem: A plant declines after several settings and inputs were changed on the same day. What is the strongest troubleshooting principle?
choices: Return controllable variables toward the prior known baseline where justified and make fewer changes so cause and response remain interpretable
Assume the newest symptom has only one possible cause
Discard the grow log because too many variables changed
rationale: Reducing confounders and comparing against a prior baseline creates better evidence than stacking additional changes.
